_comment: 飞书 IM 发送文本消息预设 (基于 4-26 跑通的配置). 用法: cd larkvision && uv run python examples/main.py --config configs/lark_im_send.json

actor_llm._comment: actor 只输出 JSON action, 不需要 grounding, 用 flash 快 3-5 倍 (4-27 性能优化)

agent.task: Send a Lark (飞书) message saying 'hello' to the contact 钟梓文. Follow these steps in order, and execute exactly one action per step. Step 1: Use the run_apple_script action with script='tell application "Lark" to activate' to force Lark to the foreground. Step 2: Use multi_Hotkey action with key1='cmd' and key2='k' to open the Lark global search dialog. Step 3: Use input_text action with text='钟梓文' to type the contact name into the search box. Step 4: Use Hotkey action with key='enter' to select the first search result and open the chat with 钟梓文. Step 5: Look at the screen. The cursor should already be focused on the message input box at the bottom. Use input_text action with text='hello' to type the message. Step 6: Use Hotkey action with key='enter' to send the message. The task is complete when the message 'hello' appears in the chat history with 钟梓文.
